observations: Real independent stdio process enables NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1, HTTP/HTTPS/ALL_PROXY and an ambient fetch override; a local broker creates a task while the proxy observes zero requests.
HTTP get_task, heartbeat and split_task produce identical 404 response bodies for a sibling task and an unknown UID; own task remains readable.
Redirect target receives zero requests; oversized body, invalid UTF-8 and source identity changes refuse initialization.
IPv6 numeric loopback initializes; an incomplete response is aborted at the 10 second deadline and its socket closes.
Non-boolean executable fails before file events or replay receipts; false/true still produce 100644/100755 modes.
Unauthenticated proxy routes are preserved; URL userinfo, query, fragment, path and invalid syntax are rejected before config creation without echoing values.

limitations: HTTP absence equivalence is not constant-time access control.
CLI/provider behavior and OS file/network isolation remain separately unverified.
Credential-bearing proxy environments require a trusted unauthenticated forwarding endpoint before launch; no such endpoint was installed or changed.
N1 temporary commit cleanup and Windows ACL, N2 runtime minimum and authorized retention, M5 native configuration and N4 review items remain open.
